items.name: ability-neutral-holy-light
items.subject: HOLY LIGHT, a forest seer's spell that heals an ally or sears an enemy: one gnarled hand of pale weathered bark, palm up and fingers spread, holding one bright burst of warm golden-white light that flares upward from the palm. Only the hand and its light: no seer, no staff, no leaves. Energy colour: warm gold and white.
